work_unit: Two-level scope guardrail for grounded document Q&A

dispatch.scope: Classify licence-related versus clearly unrelated questions and add regressions
dispatch.outcome: Worker was interrupted before delivery; the coordinator completed and verified the accepted implementation.

implementation.related_questions: Questions about a licence, its holder, residence, work or occupation remain in the grounded direct-answer and retrieval flow. Missing evidence returns the fixed unavailable answer.
implementation.unrelated_questions: Clearly unrelated topics return the fixed LicenceIQ scope guidance before embeddings, retrieval, or answer generation.
implementation.ambiguity_rule: A licence signal takes precedence over an unrelated keyword, so mixed questions remain grounded instead of being incorrectly dismissed.

verification.focused_tests: 7 guardrail cases passed, including unsupported occupation, mixed licence-plus-weather, and unrelated-topic cases.
verification.static_checks: Ruff, formatter check, and mypy passed for the changed backend files.
verification.runtime: Docker Compose rebuilt the backend and frontend. Both containers are healthy; http://127.0.0.1:8000/health and http://127.0.0.1:3000/ returned HTTP 200.
